description: Accept a suggestion application and re-publish to its CMS in place (no duplicates). Content-editor role. Failure returns a typed code (UNAUTHORIZED, RATE_LIMITED, TIMEOUT, NO_EXTERNAL_POST_ID, UPDATE_FAILED, REMOTE_POST_MISSING, REMOTE_CONTENT_CHANGED, CONCURRENT_EDIT, COMMIT_FAILED, RULES_BLOCKED, UNKNOWN). REMOTE_CONTENT_CHANGED means the CMS copy is newer - do NOT retry; the user can review and overwrite from the Guard tab.

application_id.description: Suggestion application ID to accept & re-publish

name: republish_content
